abstract: A 37-year old male patient complained of lower back pain. Investigations revealed a retroperitoneal tumor and left-sided cervical lymphadenopathy without abnormal findings in both testicles. The diagnosis of extragonadal germ cell tumor was made based on a lymph node biopsy. Following chemotherapy and retroperitoneal lymphoadenectomy, at outpatient follow-up, beta-HCG elevated again. He complained of gross hematuria, cystoscopy showed a bladder tumor, and abdominal MRI scan showed a right ureteral tumor. Total cystectomy and right nephroureterectomy were performed, which revealed that the bladder and ureteral tumors were metastatic germ cell tumors. Six months later, the patient developed hepatic and mesenteric lymph node metastases that failed to respond to treatment, and died. Germ cell tumors metastasizing to the urinary tract are extremely uncommon, and this is the first report of bladder metastases, other than through direct invasion, from an extratesticular germ cell tumor.
abstract_ja: 37歳男性が腰痛を訴えて受診した。検査で後腹膜腫瘍と左側頸部リンパ節腫脹が認められ、両側精巣には異常を認めなかった。リンパ節生検により性腺外胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。化学療法と後腹膜リンパ節郭清の後、外来フォローアップ中にβ-hCGが再上昇した。肉眼的血尿が出現し、膀胱鏡で膀胱腫瘍が見つかり、腹部磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で右尿管腫瘍が認められた。膀胱全摘除術と右腎尿管全摘除術が施行され、膀胱および尿管の腫瘍は転移性胚細胞腫瘍と判明した。6か月後に肝および腸間膜リンパ節への転移が生じ、治療に反応せず患者は死亡した。胚細胞腫瘍の尿路への転移は極めてまれであり、精巣外胚細胞腫瘍からの直接浸潤によらない膀胱転移の初の報告である。
